'''Antonio Ludeña''' (December 23, 1740 – March 1, 1820) was a [[Spaniards|Spanish]] [[Society of Jesus|Jesuit]] [[mathematician]], [[physicist]], and professor at the [[University of Camerino]].<ref>{{Cite book|last=Fuster|first=Just Pastor|title=Biblioteca valenciana de los escritores que florecieron hasta nuestros días|chapter=P. Antonio Ludeña|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3D9DAQAAMAAJ&pg=PA415|language=es|publisher=Ildefonso Mompié|location=Valencia|pages=415–416|date=1830|volume=2}}</ref>
